name: Memory Girl
source:
Memory awakens inside the data of a game, fully conscious. She walks through a fictional version of Tokyo searching for clues to the whereabouts of [b]him[/b].
She meets and gathers information from the quirky residents of Tokyo, including her best friend Messiah, her classmate Cult, who works at the arcade, and the mysterious lone elementary student Lime.
Memory's choices will influence the direction of the story, and terrifyingly unexpected events may also occur…

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
translation:
梦璃在游戏数据中觉醒了自我意识。她漫步于架空的东京，寻找[b]那个人[/b]下落的线索。
她与东京个性鲜明的居民们相遇，收集情报，其中包括好友茉西雅、在游戏厅打工的同学阿十，以及总是独自一人的神秘小学生莱姆。
梦璃的选择会影响故事的走向，甚至可能引发意想不到的恐怖事件…
